slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: The disruptive part is access, not the cable

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Most of the work in an occupied building is about getting to places: ceilings, risers, and rooms that can only be entered outside business hours. Agreeing routes, containment and access windows before starting is what keeps an installation from becoming a series of interruptions, and it is the part most often underestimated when a date is promised.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: New sites and fit-outs are considerably cheaper to cable before fit-out finishes than after, so this is worth raising early in any move. Cabling underpins everything else on the network, particularly

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: , where access point positions dictate where outlets must land.
